title: From Armchair to Action: Creating AI Video with Synthesia
html:
From Armchair to Action: Creating AI Video with Synthesia

Recently, I had started down a rabbit-hole of exploring AI podcast generation. Down one of those holes, I got side-tracked when I came across Synthesia - an AI text-to-video generation tool. I quickly asked: Could I create a short video using the Armchair Technologist narrative that I had previously written about?  The results were, frankly, astonishing.

Within about 20-30 minutes of using Synthesia for the first time, I had a polished, lifelike video. The process was remarkably intuitive.  I simply input my text, choose an avatar, fiddled a bit with the layout in a few places, and the AI did the rest, seamlessly synchronizing the avatar’s lip movements and voice to my script.  The speed and ease of use were truly impressive, especially for someone with no prior experience in video editing or AI video generation.  Leveraging my pre-existing “Armchair Technologist” narrative certainly helped streamline the process, allowing me to focus on the tool itself. See the results on Youtube or below:

The benefits of this technology are clear.  Synthesia and similar platforms can democratize video creation, empowering individuals and organizations to produce high-quality video content quickly and affordably.  Imagine the possibilities for training materials, marketing videos, personalized communications, and more.  The ability to create professional-looking videos without needing specialized equipment or technical expertise is a game-changer.

However, with such powerful technology comes significant responsibility. The ease with which realistic videos can be created also raises serious ethical concerns.  The potential for misuse, particularly in the creation of misinformation and disinformation, is a real and present danger.  Imagine how easily fabricated videos could be used to spread false narratives, manipulate public opinion, or even incite violence.  The line between genuine content and deepfakes is blurring, and the implications for society are profound.

My brief experiment with Synthesia highlighted both the immense potential and the inherent risks of AI video generation.  While the ability to create high-quality video content quickly and easily is undeniably exciting, it’s crucial that we, as a society, address the ethical challenges that this technology presents.  We need to develop robust safeguards against misuse, promote media literacy, and foster critical thinking skills to ensure that these powerful tools are used for good, not ill.  As Armchair Technologists, and indeed as citizens of the digital age, we have a responsibility to engage in these important conversations and help shape the future of AI video generation.

Andrej

—-
